turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste sir, kya main aapki madad kar sakta hoon aaj?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Haan bhai, main branch se check karwana chahta hoon TDS Connect aur PIN Prime ke baare mein.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Bilkul, cashback Click aur nominee Advantage ke liye hum ZepUdaan ya JivMitra se process shuru karenge.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Achha hai, lekin mujhe auto pay mandate lagwana bhi hai aur UPI Flex ka bhi pata chahiye.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Thik hai, hum RuvLekha ke through yeh sab set up kar denge, bas thoda wait kijiye.
